exposure: uterine artery embolization (UAE) management of cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP)
cohort: 58 women with cesarean scar pregnancy who underwent uterine artery embolization
finding: Combined laparoscopy and hysteroscopy was more effective and safer than uterine curettage for removing the ectopic conceptus and repairing tissue defects following uterine artery embolization for cesarean scar pregnancy.
